name: help
stdout:
Sentinel terminal client for the authoritative local daemon

Usage: sentinel [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  status       Connection, daemon version, uptime and runtime status
  models       Discover models through the daemon's ModelService
  model        Inspect or explicitly select the model for future requests
  sessions     List resumable daemon-owned conversations
  workspace    List, select or attach a root through daemon-owned workspace authority
  changes      Review observed workspace changes since an Agent run began
  provider     Provider readiness and discovery controls
  chat         Send a Chat message (no Agent execution)
  agent        Execute a task through AgentRuntime
  run          Execute an Agent task; alias for agent
  attach       Attach the TUI to an existing session
  tui          Open the interactive terminal interface
  doctor       Inspect installation, providers, workspace, tools and service readiness
  completions  Print shell completions; redirect to a file and install manually
  shutdown     Request authoritative daemon shutdown
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>  Output format; machine formats contain no human prose on stdout [default: text] [possible values: text, json, stream-json]
      --socket <SOCKET>  Local daemon socket endpoint [default: <LOCAL_HOME>/.sentinel/run/daemon.sock]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

Examples:
  sentinel status --output json
  echo 'inspect this repository' | sentinel run --output stream-json
  sentinel model select ollama <installed-model>
  sentinel tui

Start sentinel-daemon externally before runtime commands. No daemon or provider fallback is launched.
